newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore CFP adds two firms to trustee list.
newsitem.headline: Singapore CFP adds two firms to trustee list.

text.p: Singapore's Central Provident Board (CPF) said on Monday it had added Isetan (Singapore) Ltd and SM Summit Holdings Ltd to its list of trustee stocks.

A trustee share must have a paid-up capital of at least Singapore $15 million and a minimum shareholders' equity of S$30 million. It must also have paid dividend in each of the three preceding financial years and have made a profit in the preceding financial year.
CFP said in a statement these companies must be incorporated in Singapore and listed on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES).
With the latest additions, there are now 150 trustee shares on the SES mainboard, three on the secondary board SESDAQ, and 11 trustee loan stocks on the mainboard.
